blocks.source: Canto IV
blocks.translation: Canto IV

blocks.source: Ruppemi l’alto sonno ne la testa
blocks.translation: Broke the deep lethargy within my head

blocks.source: un greve truono, sì ch’io mi riscossi
blocks.translation: A heavy thunder, so that I upstarted,

blocks.source: come persona ch’è per forza desta;
blocks.translation: Like to a person who by force is wakened;

blocks.source: e l’occhio riposato intorno mossi,
blocks.translation: And round about I moved my rested eyes,

blocks.source: dritto levato, e fiso riguardai
blocks.translation: Uprisen erect, and steadfastly I gazed,

blocks.source: per conoscer lo loco dov’ io fossi.
blocks.translation: To recognise the place wherein I was.

blocks.source: Vero è che ’n su la proda mi trovai
blocks.translation: True is it, that upon the verge I found me

blocks.source: de la valle d’abisso dolorosa
blocks.translation: Of the abysmal valley dolorous,

blocks.source: che ’ntrono accoglie d’infiniti guai.
blocks.translation: That gathers thunder of infinite ululations.

blocks.source: Oscura e profonda era e nebulosa
blocks.translation: Obscure, profound it was, and nebulous,

blocks.source: tanto che, per ficcar lo viso a fondo,
blocks.translation: So that by fixing on its depths my sight

blocks.source: io non vi discernea alcuna cosa.
blocks.translation: Nothing whatever I discerned therein.

blocks.source: «Or discendiam qua giù nel cieco mondo»,
blocks.translation: “Let us descend now into the blind world,”

blocks.source: cominciò il poeta tutto smorto.
blocks.translation: Began the Poet, pallid utterly;

blocks.source: «Io sarò primo, e tu sarai secondo».
blocks.translation: “I will be first, and thou shalt second be.”

blocks.source: E io, che del color mi fui accorto,
blocks.translation: And I, who of his colour was aware,

blocks.source: dissi: «Come verrò, se tu paventi
blocks.translation: Said: “How shall I come, if thou art afraid,

blocks.source: che suoli al mio dubbiare esser conforto?».
blocks.translation: Who’rt wont to be a comfort to my fears?”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «L’angoscia de le genti
blocks.translation: And he to me: “The anguish of the people

blocks.source: che son qua giù, nel viso mi dipigne
blocks.translation: Who are below here in my face depicts

blocks.source: quella pietà che tu per tema senti.
blocks.translation: That pity which for terror thou hast taken.

blocks.source: Andiam, ché la via lunga ne sospigne».
blocks.translation: Let us go on, for the long way impels us.”

blocks.source: Così si mise e così mi fé intrare
blocks.translation: Thus he went in, and thus he made me enter

blocks.source: nel primo cerchio che l’abisso cigne.
blocks.translation: The foremost circle that surrounds the abyss.

blocks.source: Quivi, secondo che per ascoltare,
blocks.translation: There, as it seemed to me from listening,

blocks.source: non avea pianto mai che di sospiri
blocks.translation: Were lamentations none, but only sighs,

blocks.source: che l’aura etterna facevan tremare;
blocks.translation: That tremble made the everlasting air.

blocks.source: ciò avvenia di duol sanza martìri,
blocks.translation: And this arose from sorrow without torment,

blocks.source: ch’avean le turbe, ch’eran molte e grandi,
blocks.translation: Which the crowds had, that many were and great,

blocks.source: d’infanti e di femmine e di viri.
blocks.translation: Of infants and of women and of men.

blocks.source: Lo buon maestro a me: «Tu non dimandi
blocks.translation: To me the Master good: “Thou dost not ask

blocks.source: che spiriti son questi che tu vedi?
blocks.translation: What spirits these, which thou beholdest, are?

blocks.source: Or vo’ che sappi, innanzi che più andi,
blocks.translation: Now will I have thee know, ere thou go farther,

blocks.source: ch’ei non peccaro; e s’elli hanno mercedi,
blocks.translation: That they sinned not; and if they merit had,

blocks.source: non basta, perché non ebber battesmo,
blocks.translation: ’Tis not enough, because they had not baptism

blocks.source: ch’è porta de la fede che tu credi;
blocks.translation: Which is the portal of the Faith thou holdest;

blocks.source: e s’e’ furon dinanzi al cristianesmo,
blocks.translation: And if they were before Christianity,

blocks.source: non adorar debitamente a Dio:
blocks.translation: In the right manner they adored not God;

blocks.source: e di questi cotai son io medesmo.
blocks.translation: And among such as these am I myself.

blocks.source: Per tai difetti, non per altro rio,
blocks.translation: For such defects, and not for other guilt,

blocks.source: semo perduti, e sol di tanto offesi
blocks.translation: Lost are we and are only so far punished,

blocks.source: che sanza speme vivemo in disio».
blocks.translation: That without hope we live on in desire.”

blocks.source: Gran duol mi prese al cor quando lo ’ntesi,
blocks.translation: Great grief seized on my heart when this I heard,

blocks.source: però che gente di molto valore
blocks.translation: Because some people of much worthiness

blocks.source: conobbi che ’n quel limbo eran sospesi.
blocks.translation: I knew, who in that Limbo were suspended.

blocks.source: «Dimmi, maestro mio, dimmi, segnore»,
blocks.translation: “Tell me, my Master, tell me, thou my Lord,”

blocks.source: comincia’ io per voler esser certo
blocks.translation: Began I, with desire of being certain

blocks.source: di quella fede che vince ogne errore:
blocks.translation: Of that Faith which o’ercometh every error,

blocks.source: «uscicci mai alcuno, o per suo merto
blocks.translation: “Came any one by his own merit hence,

blocks.source: o per altrui, che poi fosse beato?».
blocks.translation: Or by another’s, who was blessed thereafter?”

blocks.source: E quei che ’ntese il mio parlar coverto,
blocks.translation: And he, who understood my covert speech,

blocks.source: rispuose: «Io era nuovo in questo stato,
blocks.translation: Replied: “I was a novice in this state,

blocks.source: quando ci vidi venire un possente,
blocks.translation: When I saw hither come a Mighty One,

blocks.source: con segno di vittoria coronato.
blocks.translation: With sign of victory incoronate.

blocks.source: Trasseci l’ombra del primo parente,
blocks.translation: Hence he drew forth the shade of the First Parent,

blocks.source: d’Abèl suo figlio e quella di Noè,
blocks.translation: And that of his son Abel, and of Noah,

blocks.source: di Moïsè legista e ubidente;
blocks.translation: Of Moses the lawgiver, and the obedient

blocks.source: Abraàm patrïarca e Davìd re,
blocks.translation: Abraham, patriarch, and David, king,

blocks.source: Israèl con lo padre e co’ suoi nati
blocks.translation: Israel with his father and his children,

blocks.source: e con Rachele, per cui tanto fé,
blocks.translation: And Rachel, for whose sake he did so much,

blocks.source: e altri molti, e feceli beati.
blocks.translation: And others many, and he made them blessed;

blocks.source: E vo’ che sappi che, dinanzi ad essi,
blocks.translation: And thou must know, that earlier than these

blocks.source: spiriti umani non eran salvati».
blocks.translation: Never were any human spirits saved.”

blocks.source: Non lasciavam l’andar perch’ ei dicessi,
blocks.translation: We ceased not to advance because he spake,

blocks.source: ma passavam la selva tuttavia,
blocks.translation: But still were passing onward through the forest,

blocks.source: la selva, dico, di spiriti spessi.
blocks.translation: The forest, say I, of thick-crowded ghosts.

blocks.source: Non era lunga ancor la nostra via
blocks.translation: Not very far as yet our way had gone

blocks.source: di qua dal sonno, quand’ io vidi un foco
blocks.translation: This side the summit, when I saw a fire

blocks.source: ch’emisperio di tenebre vincia.
blocks.translation: That overcame a hemisphere of darkness.

blocks.source: Di lungi n’eravamo ancora un poco,
blocks.translation: We were a little distant from it still,

blocks.source: ma non sì ch’io non discernessi in parte
blocks.translation: But not so far that I in part discerned not

blocks.source: ch’orrevol gente possedea quel loco.
blocks.translation: That honourable people held that place.

blocks.source: «O tu ch’onori scïenzïa e arte,
blocks.translation: “O thou who honourest every art and science,

blocks.source: questi chi son c’hanno cotanta onranza,
blocks.translation: Who may these be, which such great honour have,

blocks.source: che dal modo de li altri li diparte?».
blocks.translation: That from the fashion of the rest it parts them?”

blocks.source: E quelli a me: «L’onrata nominanza
blocks.translation: And he to me: “The honourable name,

blocks.source: che di lor suona sù ne la tua vita,
blocks.translation: That sounds of them above there in thy life,

blocks.source: grazïa acquista in ciel che sì li avanza».
blocks.translation: Wins grace in Heaven, that so advances them.”

blocks.source: Intanto voce fu per me udita:
blocks.translation: In the mean time a voice was heard by me:

blocks.source: «Onorate l’altissimo poeta;
blocks.translation: “All honour be to the pre-eminent Poet;

blocks.source: l’ombra sua torna, ch’era dipartita».
blocks.translation: His shade returns again, that was departed.”

blocks.source: Poi che la voce fu restata e queta,
blocks.translation: After the voice had ceased and quiet was,

blocks.source: vidi quattro grand’ ombre a noi venire:
blocks.translation: Four mighty shades I saw approaching us;

blocks.source: sembianz’ avevan né trista né lieta.
blocks.translation: Semblance had they nor sorrowful nor glad.

blocks.source: Lo buon maestro cominciò a dire:
blocks.translation: To say to me began my gracious Master:

blocks.source: «Mira colui con quella spada in mano,
blocks.translation: “Him with that falchion in his hand behold,

blocks.source: che vien dinanzi ai tre sì come sire:
blocks.translation: Who comes before the three, even as their lord.

blocks.source: quelli è Omero poeta sovrano;
blocks.translation: That one is Homer, Poet sovereign;

blocks.source: l’altro è Orazio satiro che vene;
blocks.translation: He who comes next is Horace, the satirist;

blocks.source: Ovidio è ’l terzo, e l’ultimo Lucano.
blocks.translation: The third is Ovid, and the last is Lucan.

blocks.source: Però che ciascun meco si convene
blocks.translation: Because to each of these with me applies

blocks.source: nel nome che sonò la voce sola,
blocks.translation: The name that solitary voice proclaimed,

blocks.source: fannomi onore, e di ciò fanno bene».
blocks.translation: They do me honour, and in that do well.”

blocks.source: Così vid’ i’ adunar la bella scola
blocks.translation: Thus I beheld assemble the fair school

blocks.source: di quel segnor de l’altissimo canto
blocks.translation: Of that lord of the song pre-eminent,

blocks.source: che sovra li altri com’ aquila vola.
blocks.translation: Who o’er the others like an eagle soars.

blocks.source: Da ch’ebber ragionato insieme alquanto,
blocks.translation: When they together had discoursed somewhat,

blocks.source: volsersi a me con salutevol cenno,
blocks.translation: They turned to me with signs of salutation,

blocks.source: e ’l mio maestro sorrise di tanto;
blocks.translation: And on beholding this, my Master smiled;

blocks.source: e più d’onore ancora assai mi fenno,
blocks.translation: And more of honour still, much more, they did me,

blocks.source: ch’e’ sì mi fecer de la loro schiera,
blocks.translation: In that they made me one of their own band;

blocks.source: sì ch’io fui sesto tra cotanto senno.
blocks.translation: So that the sixth was I, ’mid so much wit.

blocks.source: Così andammo infino a la lumera,
blocks.translation: Thus we went on as far as to the light,

blocks.source: parlando cose che ’l tacere è bello,
blocks.translation: Things saying ’tis becoming to keep silent,

blocks.source: sì com’ era ’l parlar colà dov’ era.
blocks.translation: As was the saying of them where I was.

blocks.source: Venimmo al piè d’un nobile castello,
blocks.translation: We came unto a noble castle’s foot,

blocks.source: sette volte cerchiato d’alte mura,
blocks.translation: Seven times encompassed with lofty walls,

blocks.source: difeso intorno d’un bel fiumicello.
blocks.translation: Defended round by a fair rivulet;

blocks.source: Questo passammo come terra dura;
blocks.translation: This we passed over even as firm ground;

blocks.source: per sette porte intrai con questi savi:
blocks.translation: Through portals seven I entered with these Sages;

blocks.source: giugnemmo in prato di fresca verdura.
blocks.translation: We came into a meadow of fresh verdure.

blocks.source: Genti v’eran con occhi tardi e gravi,
blocks.translation: People were there with solemn eyes and slow,

blocks.source: di grande autorità ne’ lor sembianti:
blocks.translation: Of great authority in their countenance;

blocks.source: parlavan rado, con voci soavi.
blocks.translation: They spake but seldom, and with gentle voices.

blocks.source: Traemmoci così da l’un de’ canti,
blocks.translation: Thus we withdrew ourselves upon one side

blocks.source: in loco aperto, luminoso e alto,
blocks.translation: Into an opening luminous and lofty,

blocks.source: sì che veder si potien tutti quanti.
blocks.translation: So that they all of them were visible.

blocks.source: Colà diritto, sovra ’l verde smalto,
blocks.translation: There opposite, upon the green enamel,

blocks.source: mi fuor mostrati li spiriti magni,
blocks.translation: Were pointed out to me the mighty spirits,

blocks.source: che del vedere in me stesso m’essalto.
blocks.translation: Whom to have seen I feel myself exalted.

blocks.source: I’ vidi Eletra con molti compagni,
blocks.translation: I saw Electra with companions many,

blocks.source: tra ’ quai conobbi Ettòr ed Enea,
blocks.translation: ’Mongst whom I knew both Hector and Aeneas,

blocks.source: Cesare armato con li occhi grifagni.
blocks.translation: Caesar in armour with gerfalcon eyes;

blocks.source: Vidi Cammilla e la Pantasilea;
blocks.translation: I saw Camilla and Penthesilea

blocks.source: da l’altra parte vidi ’l re Latino
blocks.translation: On the other side, and saw the King Latinus,

blocks.source: che con Lavina sua figlia sedea.
blocks.translation: Who with Lavinia his daughter sat;

blocks.source: Vidi quel Bruto che cacciò Tarquino,
blocks.translation: I saw that Brutus who drove Tarquin forth,

blocks.source: Lucrezia, Iulia, Marzïa e Corniglia;
blocks.translation: Lucretia, Julia, Marcia, and Cornelia,

blocks.source: e solo, in parte, vidi ’l Saladino.
blocks.translation: And saw alone, apart, the Saladin.

blocks.source: Poi ch’innalzai un poco più le ciglia,
blocks.translation: When I had lifted up my brows a little,

blocks.source: vidi ’l maestro di color che sanno
blocks.translation: The Master I beheld of those who know,

blocks.source: seder tra filosofica famiglia.
blocks.translation: Sit with his philosophic family.

blocks.source: Tutti lo miran, tutti onor li fanno:
blocks.translation: All gaze upon him, and all do him honour.

blocks.source: quivi vid’ ïo Socrate e Platone,
blocks.translation: There I beheld both Socrates and Plato,

blocks.source: che ’nnanzi a li altri più presso li stanno;
blocks.translation: Who nearer him before the others stand;

blocks.source: Democrito che ’l mondo a caso pone,
blocks.translation: Democritus, who puts the world on chance,

blocks.source: Dïogenès, Anassagora e Tale,
blocks.translation: Diogenes, Anaxagoras, and Thales,

blocks.source: Empedoclès, Eraclito e Zenone;
blocks.translation: Zeno, Empedocles, and Heraclitus;

blocks.source: e vidi il buono accoglitor del quale,
blocks.translation: Of qualities I saw the good collector,

blocks.source: Dïascoride dico; e vidi Orfeo,
blocks.translation: Hight Dioscorides; and Orpheus saw I,

blocks.source: Tulïo e Lino e Seneca morale;
blocks.translation: Tully and Livy, and moral Seneca,

blocks.source: Euclide geomètra e Tolomeo,
blocks.translation: Euclid, geometrician, and Ptolemy,

blocks.source: Ipocràte, Avicenna e Galïeno,
blocks.translation: Galen, Hippocrates, and Avicenna,

blocks.source: Averoìs, che ’l gran comento feo.
blocks.translation: Averroes, who the great Comment made.

blocks.source: Io non posso ritrar di tutti a pieno,
blocks.translation: I cannot all of them pourtray in full,

blocks.source: però che sì mi caccia il lungo tema,
blocks.translation: Because so drives me onward the long theme,

blocks.source: che molte volte al fatto il dir vien meno.
blocks.translation: That many times the word comes short of fact.

blocks.source: La sesta compagnia in due si scema:
blocks.translation: The sixfold company in two divides;

blocks.source: per altra via mi mena il savio duca,
blocks.translation: Another way my sapient Guide conducts me

blocks.source: fuor de la queta, ne l’aura che trema.
blocks.translation: Forth from the quiet to the air that trembles;

blocks.source: E vegno in parte ove non è che luca.
blocks.translation: And to a place I come where nothing shines.
